instantiation: Instantiate each case at each applicable matrix workflow. Frozen input, affected resources, current references, grants and expected domain writes come from that workflow row; an inapplicable provider/timer boundary is skipped, not the workflow itself.

cases.trigger: Crash separately before admission commit, after owning business commit but before response, after outbox/event/timer association commit, after external acceptance before receipt persistence, after verified progress persistence before business callback, and during multi-write callback/file finalization.
cases.expected: Uncommitted owning writes roll back together. Committed business state and original operation/send/event/timer/receipt identities remain durable. Crash never manufactures skipped/failed/cancelled/succeeded/zero usage or a second provider job/message. Associated verified progress stays observable if business callback rolled back. Incomplete file bytes are not admitted as finalized outputs. Unknown external acceptance remains unresolved until original identity reconciliation.

cases.trigger: Restart durable app workers/controller/scheduler with committed requests, pending/skipped/unknown/accepted receipts, terminal progress with null usage, failed callbacks, active timers and original replay receipts.
cases.expected: Reload original durable contracts/current owner records. Resume safe work with original identity/binding, deduplicate domain effects, recheck grants/dispatch/timer eligibility. Business-rule callback failure remains visible until cause repaired and allowed reconcile re-notification; terminal unknown usage remains held. Reopened browser reads current retained run; no automatic new inference or review/notice. Provider restart losing unobserved output remains unknown.

cases.applies_to: Every workflow including read/page projections and shared owners
cases.trigger: Change release/schema/adapter/provider endpoint/account/key namespace/installed capability while retained schedules, outbox intents, running/accepted/unknown requests, replay receipts, files and cross-package owner references exist; interrupt activation or partially restore.
cases.expected: Close affected admissions and fence all writers; preserve installed predecessor. Inventory old work, then drain/reconcile or retain compatible old release/binding/account/identity namespace for it. Never resend uncertain original work through a different account as retry. Restore compatible release/config/database/files/owner inventories/work contracts/provider associations together; validate exact references before reopening. Missing old account/file/owner or partial restore stays closed and unresolved. Restored local state cannot undo delivered email or completed generation; reconcile external observations accepted after checkpoint.
cases.missing_details: Concrete versions, compatible adapter migrations, installed graph resources, database/file checkpoints and restore procedures are not supplied by the app drafts.

cases.applies_to: All page and browser interaction rows
cases.trigger: Tab/controller/browser crashes during form submission, polling, streaming, upload, modal reason edit, thumbnail or download; independent controller continues.
cases.expected: Browser loss alone neither cancels nor completes external work. Finalized file and committed record remain unchanged. Canonical operation result can be reread under current grants; unfinished upload never becomes submitted immutable version. Shared draft retention/discard confirmation and accessible failure presentation require browser evidence.

cases.applies_to: All page and browser interaction rows
cases.trigger: Reconnect/reload/reopen after generation/decision response loss, role/site/reviewer reassignment, conversation revoke or account removal.
cases.expected: Read current authorized retained snapshots and original operation results. Rerender allowed controls and leaves, preserve surviving drafts/errors, navigate to current authorized revision on conflict. Never resubmit solely because browser reconnected. Previously valid URL or cached ID is not an access grant.

cases.applies_to: Every canonical operation/read exposed through generated MCP, if exposure is enabled
cases.trigger: Invoke tool directly with exact current reference/version, then stale/foreign/cross-team/cross-site reference, changed same-ID payload, hidden leaf filter/aggregate or caller-supplied provider outcome.
cases.expected: Same canonical owning operation/actor/current-grant/revision and replay results as browser; tool cannot bypass budget/profile/published workflow/assignment/self-review/file grants. Denied leaves cannot serialize or enter filters/aggregates. Ordinary tool cannot forge progress, Notice.created, Due or EmployeeChanged. Technical provisioning/provider switching has no MCP business tool.
cases.missing_details: App .can declares operations/pages, not an implemented MCP transport or tested tool descriptors.

cases.applies_to: Every operation and read accepting owning/cross-package/file references
cases.trigger: Pass nonexistent, foreign-owner/team/location, unreadable, wrong-type or stale-version ID; revoke grant between picker/render and canonical invoke or bytes fetch.
cases.expected: Owning source validates actual current typed reference and exact grant; stale version fails before writes where supplied. Error must not disclose hidden metadata. File references/exports do not transfer authority. Consequential decision reevaluates current eligible reviewer/profile/workflow/conversation, not cached choices.

cases.trigger: Attempt execution acceptance with source-only/generated-JavaScript fixture, no pinned provider/resource allowlist/backend/file profile, or a changed deployment profile.
cases.expected: Evidence remains a desired source contract. Required real provider and durable/file profile outcomes remain open; fixture bytes/typed validation/receipt recipes/syntax checks cannot imply working inference, email dispatch, uploads, grant serialization, browser renderer, replay, timer or restore.

cases.trigger: Reader/controller crashes mid-query, serialization, file authorization or response; mutable receipt/grant changes at read boundary.
cases.expected: No business mutation/send/accounting/timer caused by read or its failure. Withhold incomplete unauthorized response; do not reinterpret read failure as empty authoritative eligibility or successful download. Snapshot/grant fence preserves allowed leaves without leaking private data.

cases.trigger: Reopen read after reader/app restart while source records, grants, membership, assignment or receipt status changed.
cases.expected: Read current authorized owner snapshot and actual requested immutable revision as appropriate; no cached permission, implicit mutable-record rewrite, provider resubmission or fabricated eligibility. Missing owner/file is explicit unavailable/recovery gap.
